summary: Debugging discussion: request timeouts and connection pooling.

utterances.speaker: other
utterances.text: Walk me through the bug you were chasing.

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: The request was timing out, and I wasn't sure if it was the retry logic or the connection pool.

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: I tried increasing the pool size — actually, wait, that made it worse.

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: I don't fully understand why the pool starves under load.

utterances.speaker: other
utterances.text: Pools are tricky. What did the metrics show?

utterances.speaker: me
utterances.text: The pool wait time spiked, so I think it's contention, but I want to review connection pooling.
